description: Assessing fuel structure in hurricane-impacted stands on the north shore of Prince Edward Island, Canada is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. We present a dataset of measurements and observations of combustible live and dead vegetation (also known as fuel structure) in ten stands impacted by hurricanes along the north shore of Prince Edward Island, Canada. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are fuel structure, fire behaviour, structure du combustible, comportement du feu. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
